using Base64
const PAYLOAD = ""
const DEADLINE = 500.0
const HARD = DEADLINE + 60.0
const CAP = 420.0
const STALL = 150.0
const CHILD = String(base64decode(""))
function unxz(src, dst)
    if Sys.which("xz") !== nothing && get(ENV, "STADE_FORCE_7Z", "") != "1"
        run(pipeline(`xz -dc $src`, stdout = dst))
    else
        Core.eval(Main, :(import p7zip_jll))
        p7 = Base.invokelatest(() -> Main.p7zip_jll.p7zip())
        run(pipeline(`$p7 x -txz -so $src`, stdout = dst))
    end
end
function unbundle()
    dir = mktempdir(); xz = joinpath(dir, "b.xz"); raw = joinpath(dir, "b.bin")
    write(xz, base64decode(PAYLOAD)); unxz(xz, raw)
    blob = read(raw); out = Pair{String,Vector{UInt8}}[]; pos = 1
    while pos <= length(blob)
        e1 = findnext(==(0x0a), blob, pos); name = String(blob[pos:e1 - 1])
        e2 = findnext(==(0x0a), blob, e1 + 1); len = parse(Int, String(blob[e1 + 1:e2 - 1]))
        push!(out, name => blob[e2 + 1:e2 + len]); pos = e2 + len + 1
    end
    return out
end
rowjson(r) = "{\"name\":\"" * r["name"] * "\",\"exit\":" * string(r["exit"]) * ",\"seconds\":" * string(r["seconds"]) * ",\"skipped\":" * string(r["skipped"]) *
             ",\"result\":" * (startswith(r["last_line"], "{") ? r["last_line"] : "null") * ",\"stderr_tail\":" * repr(r["stderr_tail"]) * "}"
function runone(name, bytes, cap)
    dir = mktempdir(); f = joinpath(dir, name * ".jl"); write(f, bytes)
    so = joinpath(dir, "out.txt"); se = joinpath(dir, "err.txt")
    t0 = time()
    proc = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(`timeout -k 5 $(round(Int, cap)) $(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$(Base.active_project()) $f`); stdout = so, stderr = se))
    el = time() - t0
    lines = filter(!isempty, split(read(so, String), "\n"))
    last = isempty(lines) ? "" : String(lines[end])
    err = read(se, String)
    return Dict("name" => name, "exit" => proc.exitcode, "seconds" => round(el; digits = 1), "last_line" => last,
                "stderr_tail" => err[max(1, end - 1500):end], "skipped" => false)
end
skipped(n, why) = Dict("name" => n, "exit" => -1, "seconds" => 0.0, "last_line" => "", "stderr_tail" => "skipped: " * why, "skipped" => true)
# an in-process batch: restarts the child after a crash or a stall, until every script has a row or time is out
function runbatch(items, t00)
    res = Any[]; todo = copy(items)
    dir = mktempdir(); cf = joinpath(dir, "child.jl"); write(cf, CHILD)
    while !isempty(todo)
        if time() - t00 > DEADLINE
            for (n, _) in todo; push!(res, skipped(n, "deadline")); end
            break
        end
        man = joinpath(dir, "manifest.txt"); resf = joinpath(dir, "res.jsonl"); rm(resf; force = true)
        open(man, "w") do io
            for (n, b) in todo
                p = joinpath(dir, n * ".jl"); write(p, b); println(io, n, "\t", p)
            end
        end
        so = joinpath(dir, "child.out"); se = joinpath(dir, "child.err")
        proc = run(pipeline(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$(Base.active_project()) $cf $man $resf`; stdout = so, stderr = se); wait = false)
        last_n = 0; last_t = time()
        while process_running(proc)
            sleep(2.0)
            n = isfile(resf) ? countlines(resf) : 0
            if n != last_n; last_n = n; last_t = time(); end
            if time() - last_t > STALL || time() - t00 > HARD
                kill(proc); sleep(1.0); process_running(proc) && kill(proc, Base.SIGKILL)
                break
            end
        end
        wait(proc)
        rows = isfile(resf) ? filter(!isempty, readlines(resf)) : String[]
        done = Set{String}()
        for l in rows
            nm = match(r"\"name\":\"([^\"]*)\"", l).captures[1]
            push!(done, nm)
            push!(res, Dict("rawrow" => l, "name" => nm))
        end
        rest = [(n, b) for (n, b) in todo if !(n in done)]
        if !isempty(rest)
            code = proc.exitcode
            stalled = (time() - last_t > STALL) || (time() - t00 > HARD)
            n1 = rest[1][1]
            errtxt = isfile(se) ? (s = read(se, String); s[max(1, end - 1500):end]) : ""
            push!(res, Dict("name" => n1, "exit" => stalled ? 124 : (code == 0 ? 99 : code), "seconds" => 0.0, "last_line" => "", "stderr_tail" => (stalled ? "stalled or out of time; " : "child died; ") * errtxt, "skipped" => false))
            rest = rest[2:end]
        end
        todo = rest
    end
    return res
end
function main()
    t00 = time()
    items = try unbundle() catch e; println("{\"host\":\"" * gethostname() * "\",\"error\":" * repr(sprint(showerror, e)) * ",\"runs\":[]}"); return end
    iso = sort([(n, b) for (n, b) in items if !startswith(n, "P_")]; by = first)
    inp = sort([(n, b) for (n, b) in items if startswith(n, "P_")]; by = first)
    rows = String[]
    for (n, b) in iso
        r = time() - t00 > DEADLINE ? skipped(n, "deadline") : runone(n, b, max(30.0, min(CAP, HARD - (time() - t00))))
        push!(rows, rowjson(r))
    end
    if !isempty(inp)
        for r in runbatch(inp, t00)
            push!(rows, haskey(r, "rawrow") ? replace(r["rawrow"], r"^\{" => "{\"skipped\":false,") : rowjson(r))
        end
    end
    println("{\"host\":\"" * gethostname() * "\",\"total_seconds\":" * string(round(time() - t00; digits = 1)) * ",\"runs\":[" * join(rows, ",") * "]}")
end
main()
